M-BUN-VERSION-GUARD.Summary: Refuses to run the toolchain on a Bun older than engines.bun in package.json.

M-REVIEW-GATE.Summary: Runs the whole check suite for Spec Kitty's review gate and writes one JUnit report with a test case per check.

M-REPOSITORY-MODEL.Summary: Describes the repository as a Telos model: one Locus per package, application and tooling area, with its purpose, source claims, external packages and dependency relations.

M-TELOS-COMMAND.Summary: Runs the bun run telos developer command over the repository model: list, inspect, verify, closure, impact, check and report, each printing one JSON document.
